name: inventory-orders-generation
description: Generation benchmark for the newly authored synthetic Python project generation-eval/repos/inventory-orders (inventory and order management; 30 ingested files; frozen at commit 1cb147d before any question was written). 24 answerable questions across implementation, architecture, symbol lookup, cross-module behaviour, configuration, edge cases and documented limitations, plus 6 unanswerable questions. Key facts quote or paraphrase only the cited source text.
contamination_notes: The repository was written for this study and has never been published, so a model cannot have seen it; this is its purpose. It is authored by the same project team as the benchmark and by an AI assistant, so its style may resemble code a model finds familiar, and its domain (inventory and orders) is a common textbook one.
limitations: Synthetic: small (30 files), single-author, standard-library only and written to be clear; real repositories are larger, noisier and less consistent, so effects measured here may not transfer.
Not independent: the same team wrote the code, the questions and the key facts.
24 answerable and 6 unanswerable questions: differences of a few questions are within noise.
Many answers are visible in a single function, which favours retrieval of function-sized chunks.
Unanswerable questions concern external or operational facts that cannot be in the code; they test abstention, not near-miss discrimination.
